# Bernius Consulting

> B2B digital marketing audits — scored 0–100 across 7 pillars with USD revenue-gap estimates per finding. Based in Mexico City.

Primary audience: small and medium B2B companies (10-200 employees) whose digital presence isn't converting — generalist agencies have not fixed the problem, and leadership wants a scored, prioritized, revenue-tied diagnosis rather than vague recommendations.

## Core Services

- **360° Digital Presence Audit**: Full scored audit (7 pillars, 28+ sub-checks), 48h delivery, $8K/month recoverable-revenue guarantee. From $497. See /pricing.md.
- **Lead Generation Systems**: Apollo prospecting + cold email sequencing + LinkedIn outreach + CRM integration. Custom pricing.
- **AI Automations**: n8n + Claude-powered workflow automation. n8n certified. Custom pricing.
- **CRM Setup & Strategy**: HubSpot CRM setup, pipeline design, sales automation. HubSpot certified. Custom pricing.
- **Social Media Growth**: Research, content calendar, copywriting, video, publishing, reporting. Custom pricing.
- **Claude Code Training**: Live 4-day workshop (2h/day), for founders/operators. $150/person, max 6 seats/cohort.
- **AI Content Engine**: Free 12-article content blueprint + first article; pay-per-article after, no subscription.
